driverInstallation.windows: Download Brother MFC-L5900DW driver from brother.com/support. Run full driver package installer. Select network connection and let installer find printer automatically. Includes PCL and BR-Script (PostScript) drivers. Optional: Install Brother iPrint&Scan for enhanced features.
driverInstallation.mac: Download macOS driver from brother.com or use AirPrint for basic printing. For full features, install Brother driver package. Add printer via System Preferences > Printers & Scanners. Install Brother iPrint&Scan app for scanning and mobile features.
driverInstallation.linux: Download Brother Linux driver from support site or use system's printer configuration. Brother provides DEB and RPM packages. Configure via CUPS at localhost:631. Most features including duplex and network printing supported.

configPages.meterPage: Touchscreen: Information > Machine Info > Page Counter. Shows total pages, duplex pages, and 2-in-1 pages.
configPages.configPage: Touchscreen: Information > Print Reports > Printer Settings
configPages.webInterface: Access Brother web-based management at http://[printer-ip]. No password required by default. Configure all settings, check status, manage users, view logs.

commonErrors.description: Drum unit near end of life
causes: Drum unit approaching or at 30,000 page life
Drum counter needs reset after replacement
solutions: Order replacement DR-820 drum unit
Continue printing until 'Replace Drum' appears
Replace drum unit when print quality degrades
After installing new drum, reset counter:
Open front cover, press Clear/Back button
Press Up Arrow button, select '1' to reset
Close front cover
Note the specific error number (e.g., Machine Error 76)
Turn printer off using power switch
Wait 10 seconds
Turn printer back on
If error persists, note error code
Contact Brother support with error code
May require service depending on error number

firmware.updateProcedure: Access web interface at http://[printer-ip]. Navigate to Administrator > Firmware Update. Check for updates automatically or upload firmware file from brother.com/support. Printer will reboot during update - do not power off. Update takes approximately 10 minutes.
